goal: Lane preferences move from tracked instruction-file directives to one personal gitignored preset .imm/lanes.local.json with named profiles and an active field (default = current host config), the request may name a profile and overlay fields per batch, the Batch final verification directive is removed in favor of request -> repository prose -> none, and a new ADR, reference exception and major changeset record the breaking change (#327; Spec docs/specs/lane-preferences-local-preset.spec.md D1-D9).

acceptance.assertion: Per D1-D4 of docs/specs/lane-preferences-local-preset.spec.md (sources #327-Design, G-Q3..Q6): plugins/immune-brain/dist/drive-batch.md '#### Lane Preferences' (heading and anchor kept) states that the Parent alone reads .imm/lanes.local.json at its checkout root, with top-level keys active and profiles only (no contract field), profile fields max_parallel, executor_host, executor_model, executor_effort, unnamed fields falling back to the default column, a request naming a profile and overlaying fields for one batch, and a display line with per-field sources request / preset:<profile> / default. Positive: those fragments are present. Negative: each D4 case is named as reported with no batch started (malformed JSON, unknown profile in active, unknown profile in a request, unknown key, non-positive max_parallel, host outside pi/claude-code), profile model/effort without that profile's executor_host is reported and not applied, and the rows 'Lane max parallel:', 'Lane Executor Host:', 'Lane Executor model:', 'Lane Executor effort:' are absent. Bound: batch_lanes.ts, batch_runner.ts and role_prompt_bridge.ts name neither lanes.local.json nor the old directives. Agreed seam: tests/role-prompt-bridge.test.ts.
